title: GraphicRouter — verified local workflow
idea: Plan a presentation story, compose separate slide elements, and support precise revisions.

slides.headline:
A small change.
A lot of rework.
slides.notes: Imagine your presentation is nearly ready. You want to change one headline, but you also need the rest of the deck to stay consistent. Our starting question is simple: can an AI-assisted workflow give us that control? GraphicRouter makes the presentation an explicit plan of editable elements. This pitch is generated by the same slide engine we are showing today.

slides.headline:
Give every slide
a clear blueprint.
slides.notes: GraphicRouter combines three responsibilities: plan the message from supplied facts, compose separate slide elements, and direct a precise change. ChatGPT supplies the story through structured tool arguments. The engine and service now work together locally: create, preview, revise, and export are verified. The hosted ChatGPT connection still needs its account check.

slides.headline:
Brief. Blueprint.
Editable elements.
slides.notes: The blueprint records the elements, their content, positions, order, and styles. We use that same data for the layout preview, content preview, finished preview, and PowerPoint. That gives us a concrete source of truth to inspect and revise. The renderer checks text fit and slide bounds. If copy does not fit, it returns a clear error instead of silently shrinking or discarding it.

slides.headline:
Change one element.
Keep the rest.
slides.notes: This deck uses our engine. Now change only slide three's headline to violet. [Allow thirty seconds for the local service demonstration, or identify the prepared engine replay explicitly.] The new version preserves the original and every unrelated element. Separately, a manual Canva import preserved editable text and images. Canva shape editing and the application's own import path still need verification.

slides.headline:
Working locally.
Ready for account checks.
slides.notes: Today, the engine and service work together locally, with construction previews, native exports, and precise revisions. Next we restore access to the existing Site, configure Canva application credentials, verify the hosted workflow, and rehearse the pitch. GraphicRouter makes presentations you can direct: plan the story, compose the slides, and preserve what is already right.

preservation: Only the slide-three headline colour changes. The original and unrelated content are preserved.
